text:
Lena (product): Heads up 1: new private deployment plan for BetaCorp. We need to reconcile packaging, upgrade path, and customer-managed networking expectations. Key constraints: zero public IP exposure, support HA across two racks, upgrade with <30m downtime target.

Arjun (eng): Noted. For upgrade path we should support in-place patch + staged canary. For major version bumps, propose blue/green. Agree on <30m for patch windows if we automate DB migrations.

Priya (netops): Customer insists on managing their own peering and NAT. We'll provide a peering manifest and prescriptive route table templates. Also need to document IP preservation and VRF considerations.

Ethan (solutions): BetaCorp wants a dry-run mode and manifest validator so their infra team can simulate. Also asking for example IAM roles for KMS usage.

Maya (cs): BetaCorp requires compression of logs and retention policy 180 days for compliance. Also they want an SLA on upgrade success within the service contract.

Arjun (eng): Packaging options: OCI container images served via private repo + tarball for air-gapped. Include checksums and GPG signatures. Add an 'installer verify' step to run post-install checks.

Priya (netops): For customer-managed NAT we need a clear UX: 1) optional flag to disable internal egress, 2) instructions for building an outbound proxy, 3) firewall rules snippet.

Lena (product): Action items: Arjun update packaging artifacts + verify step; Priya produce peering + NAT UX doc; Ethan deliver manifest validator PoC; Maya draft customer SLA language and retention notes.

DeployBot: Suggested upgrade window: 2024-06-02 01:30-02:30 UTC. Tagging "requires-approval".

Lena (product): Let's target that. Ping once artifacts are on staging. We'll run a runbook dry-run with BetaCorp next week.

Arjun (eng): I'll push container images to staging and upload tarballs. Will also add 'installer verify' output to console logs.

Ethan (solutions): working on the validator. will post examples in docs channel when ready.

Priya (netops): One more ask: include a troubleshooting matrix for routing failures and common ip conflicts.

Maya (cs): I'll confirm compliance checklist with BetaCorp security.

Lena (product): Nice. Meeting Friday for signoff. :calendar:
